name: empty-input
note: zero bytes yield zero lines

name: plain-lf
note: LF text passes through unchanged

name: trailing-lf
note: a trailing newline does not add an empty line

name: bom-stripped
note: leading UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF) is removed

name: bom-only
note: a file that is only a BOM has no lines

name: bom-mid-file-preserved
note: only the leading BOM is stripped; U+FEFF elsewhere is content

name: cr-newlines
note: lone CR is a newline

name: crlf-newlines
note: CRLF is one newline

name: mixed-newlines
note: CRLF, CR and LF mixed in one file

name: crlf-then-cr
note: CRLF followed by CR is two newlines; the empty line between them is dropped

name: trailing-cr
note: a trailing lone CR does not add an empty line

name: tab-runs
note: runs of tabs collapse to one space

name: space-runs-trimmed
note: runs of spaces collapse; leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed

name: nbsp-is-horizontal-whitespace
note: U+00A0 (Zs) collapses like a space and is trimmed at the ends

name: ideographic-space
note: U+3000 (Zs) collapses like a space

name: mixed-horizontal-whitespace
note: a run mixing tab, space and NBSP is one space

name: empty-lines-dropped
note: empty and whitespace-only lines are dropped; nothing else is

name: leading-empty-lines
note: empty lines at the start are dropped too

name: nfc-composed
note: decomposed e + U+0301 becomes U+00E9

name: nfc-already-composed
note: already-NFC text is unchanged

name: nfc-hangul
note: Hangul jamo (U+1112 U+1161 U+11AB) compose to U+D55C

name: vertical-whitespace-preserved
note: form feed and vertical tab are neither horizontal whitespace nor newlines

name: unicode-line-separator-preserved
note: U+2028 and U+0085 are not newlines; they stay inside the line

name: line-order-and-count
note: five non-empty lines stay five lines in order

name: interior-single-space-kept
note: single spaces between tokens are kept

name: multibyte-content
note: multibyte UTF-8 is decoded, not split

name: invalid-utf8-lead-byte
note: 0xFF is never valid UTF-8

name: invalid-utf8-truncated-sequence
note: a 3-byte sequence cut after 2 bytes

name: invalid-utf8-overlong
note: overlong encoding of '/' (C0 AF)

name: invalid-utf8-surrogate
note: encoded UTF-16 surrogate (ED A0 80) is invalid UTF-8

name: invalid-utf8-latin1
note: Latin-1 e-acute (E9) alone is rejected, not silently replaced
